definitions.explanation: Indicates that something happens prior to another event or time.
Indicates a position in front of something.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べる{前|まえ}に{手|て}を{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: I wash my hands before eating.
examples.notes: Time: verb dictionary form + 前に

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んでください。
examples.english: Please read a book before going to bed.

examples.japanese: {出|で}かける{前|まえ}にドアを{閉|し}めてください。
examples.english: Please close the door before going out.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{始|はじ}まる{前|まえ}に、{毎日|まいにち}コーヒーを{飲|の}んでいます。
examples.english: I drink coffee every day before work starts.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{部屋|へや}を{暗|くら}くして、{静|しず}かな{音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}くと、{眠|ねむ}りやすくなります。
examples.english: If you make the room dark and listen to quiet music before sleeping at night, it becomes easier to fall asleep.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{前|まえ}に{会|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's meet in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{前|まえ}に{大|おお}きな{木|き}があります。
examples.english: There's a big tree in front of the school.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{前|まえ}に{座|すわ}ってお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: Please sit in front of me and wait.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}は{公園|こうえん}の{前|まえ}にあります。{歩|ある}いて5{分|ふん}ぐらいです。
examples.english: The library is in front of the park. It's about a 5-minute walk.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}の{前|まえ}に{立|た}っている{大|おお}きな{木|き}は、{祖父|そふ}が{若|わか}いころにここに{持|も}ってきたもので、{今|いま}では{家族|かぞく}の{思|おも}い{出|で}になっています。
examples.english: The big tree standing in front of the house was brought here by my grandfather when he was young, and now it has become a family memory.

notes:
{前|まえ}に has two distinct uses: temporal (before) and spatial (in front of).

TIME PATTERNS:
- [verb dictionary form] + {前|まえ}に: before doing...
- [noun] + の{前|まえ}に: before [noun]

LOCATION PATTERN:
- [noun] + の{前|まえ}に: in front of [noun]

OPPOSITES:
- Time: {後|あと}で / {後|あと}に (after)
- Location: {後|うし}ろに (behind)

{前|まえ}に VS {前|まえ}:
{前|まえ}に emphasizes the point in time/space; {前|まえ} alone can modify nouns ({前|まえ}の{日|ひ} = the previous day).

NOTE: Unlike {後|あと}で, {前|まえ}に always uses に, never で.
